$comment: AskCarnivore index — hand-curated, git-versioned. This is the whole product.
EVERY ENTRY BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER. The URLs point at example.com on purpose:
nothing here must ever be served as a real source. While `status` is
"PLACEHOLDER" the bot shows a warning banner and the QA gate refuses to pass.
Nick replaces `entries` with the real curated content and flips `status` to
"CURATED" in the same commit — never separately.
Fields (Bot v0 spec §2):
id            stable slug, referenced by the model. NEVER reuse an id for a
different video — the worker resolves links from this file.
topic         canonical topic key, lowercase-kebab.
topic_aliases how a human might say it, EL + EN. Union'd per topic at load.
type          conceptual | testimonial | practical
creator       display name, exactly as the creator writes it.
register      depth | breadth | layman | persona | pending   (§14.4)
`pending` = topic yes, register not judged yet (§14.11).
lang          en | el — the language spoken in the video, not of the title.
title         the video's own title. Not our words.
url           verified watch URL. The model never sees this field.
label         OUR framing of the link (§8). Curated for anything sensitive;
null = the model writes it under the link-label rules.
flagship      optional pin for a signature topic (§14.3).
Rules that outlive this file: link-out only, never rehost, never transcripts.
Labels are experience/position, never a treatment claim.
